sequence: Independent Reviewer submits the effective PASS or post_reveal_amendment while holding the Reviewer-owned reviewer lease.
Reviewer releases that lease and verifies through lease.status that the Reviewer-owned active lease is gone.
Adjudicator independently verifies the verdict, findings, evidence and release receipt.
Adjudicator acquires a fresh lease with lease role=reviewer and holder agent_id/session_id/model_id equal to the Adjudicator's own registered coordinates; the raw token remains memory-only.
Adjudicator calls task.apply and task.close with role=adjudicator plus its holder-matching finalizer token and fencing counter.
Adjudicator releases the finalizer lease, verifies task.next_action=COMPLETE, and records acquire/apply/close/release/COMPLETE provenance without any raw token.
invariants: Reviewer and Adjudicator never share or transfer a raw lease token.
Reviewer-owned and Adjudicator-owned leases are distinct rows with monotonically increasing fencing counters.
task.apply/task.close use the same agent_id/session_id/model_id stored on the active finalizer lease.
A missing release, acquire, holder match, fencing value or COMPLETE projection fails closed.

evidence.immutability_rule: The input artifact is frozen after the Reviewer-owned Gate lease is acquired and before attestation, then never edited. evidence_writer.rule: It may serialize already returned daemon values into the three whitelisted evidence paths, but it may not decide PASS/BLOCKED, acquire a governance role, mutate task authority, infer missing values or edit an artifact after hashing.
